subject: Follow-up: Payment onboarding checkpoint — PO vs corporate card & procurement constraints
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@saturnai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Payment onboarding checkpoint — PO vs corporate card & procurement constraints

Hi Liam — great conversation today, thanks for the context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align your commercial path: 

Recap from our call:
- Primary goal: 3-month pilot for inference on dedicated capacity, expected consumption ~$6–9k (pilot).
- Procurement signal: procurement prefers PO for multi-year/committed spends; pilots commonly run on corporate card if <$10k.
- Tools: SaturnAI uses Coupa for PO intake and Airbase for card reconciliation.

Open items we need to close to pick a path:
1) Procurement lead + contact for PO paperwork (name/email).
2) Pilot budget owner confirmation and expected cap. If pilot exceeds ~$10k, procurement will push PO route.
3) Marketplace interest: you flagged GCP marketplace — do you want us to pursue listing as part of procurement ease?

Suggested next steps (short timeline):
- We can support a card-led pilot for up to $8k while procurement drafts a PO (if they want a PO afterward we’ll switch billing).
- If procurement needs PO from the start, share the Coupa vendor setup checklist and we’ll assign an onboarding specialist.
- I attached a short "commercial path" one-pager with two recommended flows (card-first pilot, PO onboarding).

Can you please: (a) confirm procurement contact and (b) confirm pilot budget cap by end of day Friday? I can have legal/finance prepare SOW + W-9 immediately.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-commercial-path-options.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@saturnai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: SaturnAI Procurement <procurement@saturnai.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Payment onboarding checkpoint — PO vs corporate card & procurement constraints

Thanks Kim — appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from procurement side (copying procurement alias):

- For pilots: finance is generally comfortable charging up to $10k on a corporate card for POC work. Anything expected above that should be routed through a PO. Your ~$6–9k estimate should be fine on card.
- Our procurement team requires a vendor setup in Coupa for any PO. Typical lead time: 3–6 weeks (depends on docs).
- Required docs for PO: W-9, Master Services Agreement (if not already in place), and a simple SOW for the pilot. We can share Coupa vendor onboarding link after vendor info is submitted.
- Marketplace: yes — GCP Marketplace would be preferred long-term since it simplifies procurement and invoicing. We're interested but not a blocker for the pilot.

Procurement contact: Taylor Nguyen (procurement@saturnai.com).

We'd like to run the pilot on card initially and convert to PO if we move to committed capacity after the pilot. Please send the W-9 and draft SOW and I'll make introductions to Taylor.

Best,
Liam

Kim — quick internal note before we finalize:
- If they accept card for the pilot, let's offer an $8k cap to keep within their comfort zone and avoid triggering a PO.
- We'll prepare a lightweight SOW (1 page) and W-9; legal to review but should be fast.
- If they indicate marketplace is important, flag growth ops to evaluate listing feasibility — that could accelerate larger deals later.

I'll draft the SOW template and loop in Marissa for onboarding requirements. Want me to send the draft to Liam directly or would you prefer to own that touch?

2) Proposed billing flow: start pilot on corporate card (card cap suggested: $8k). If you convert to committed capacity, we will transition invoicing to PO and support Coupa vendor onboarding.
3) I'll introduce our onboarding lead (Marissa) to Taylor to start vendor setup in Coupa if/when they want PO. Marissa — can you take point on vendor setup checklist and expected timelines?

Liam — can you confirm that Taylor is the right procurement contact and that $8k on card sounds acceptable to finance? Once we have that confirmation we'll send the SOW and kickoff docs.
